body:
### Summary

Hello uv folks.

In Fedora, we have triaged several already disclosed CVEs from pypa/virtualenv as they were reported to the uv package as well (reasons not important, happy to explain). With LLM (Claude Sonnet 5) I have found that CVE-2026-113721 is reproducible in uv 0.13.6 on Fedora Linux.

https://github.com/pypa/virtualenv/commit/d25f28699eefb1fc34a251e5adf2b5de844c36cd

uv writes every generated file (activation scripts, .gitignore, _virtualenv.py/.pth) with a bare create-or-truncate open that follows symlinks, so `uv venv --allow-existing` over a directory containing a pre-planted file symlink overwrites whatever that symlink points to, including files outside the venv.

    mkdir -p v/bin
    echo SENSITIVE > outside_file
    ln -s "$PWD/outside_file" v/bin/activate
    uv venv --allow-existing v
    cat outside_file   # overwritten with the generated activate script content 

I have reported this to security at astral.sh but this does not constitute vulnerability within uv’s attacker and threat models, hence I am reporting this as a regular bug.

### Platform

Fedora Linux

### Version

0.13.6

### Python version

any
title: Generated files can follow existing destination links
